subject: Socket emission latency — advisory & interim mitigations
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novacart.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Socket emission latency — advisory & interim mitigations

Hi Samir,

I wanted to reach out proactively: we detected transient delays impacting streamed token delivery for a subset of NovaCart sessions between ~07:45-09:05 PDT this morning. Users may have seen pauses of 4–12s in streaming responses before the model resumed output.

We believe the root cause is edge-proxy backpressure combined with a recent worker-side scheduling tweak that increase dgram emit aggregation (we're calling it a "socket emit" path). Our infra team has a mitigation running now, and we expect to keep service stable while we validate a longer-term fix.

Short-term actions we recommend to reduce user-visible impact immediately:
- Enable client-side incremental-polling fallback (if you can tolerate a ~200ms poll cadence)
- Lower stream_batch_size to 8 tokens for high-concurrency endpoints
- Add a short client-side reconnect/backoff (250ms -> 1s) for stalled streams

We'll share a timeline for the post-incident analysis and a remediation plan by EOD tomorrow. I'm looping Stephanie (Escalations) for the technical details and Marissa (CS) for any commercial/credits conversations.

Attachments: socket_logs_20260901.txt (snip), latency_dashboard_20260901.png

Thanks,
Jonas

2) What is your ETA for a durable fix? Our ops team will need guidance on whether to enable polling or temporarily route traffic.

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:05:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Socket emission latency — advisory & interim mitigations

Hi Samir,

Thanks for the quick reply — short answers first:
- Impact: limited to streaming/real-time socket emission paths. Non-streaming generation (sync REST calls) were not affected by the backpressure pattern we observed.
- ETA for durable fix: we have a staged deployment planned for Wed morning (09/02) to revert the scheduling tweak and add tighter emit batching thresholds; full validation complete by EOD Wed.

Technical context (concise):
- What happened: an optimization change pushed last week altered the socket emit aggregator so that under certain concurrency patterns it delayed flushes to optimize throughput. Unfortunately, in our edge-proxy setup this triggered queue buildup and occasional 4–12s stalls before a reconnect/flush.
- How we mitigated: we rolled the scheduling change back on the affected fleet and applied a temporary throttling rule at the edge to prioritize small emit flushes. Early telemetry shows median streaming latency returning to baseline within 20 minutes of the rollback.

Immediate customer-facing mitigations (we can push these to you as a config snippet):
1) client: set stream_batch_size=8 and max_tokens_per_emit=12 (reduces aggregation window)
2) client: implement polling fallback (200–500ms) for critical flows where stall visibility is worse than slightly higher latency
3) server: if you have Dedicated seats, we can temporarily route high-concurrency sessions to your dedicated pool (minimizes cross-tenant edge contention)

Attached is a short config snippet (temp-config-snippet.txt) we can paste into your SDK settings.

We will provide a formal postmortem after engineering completes the root cause and the follow-on mitigations (expected Thu). If you prefer, Marissa can schedule a 30-min bridge to walk your ops team through applying the snippet now.

Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Escalations Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com

Hi Samir — I can run the bridge and help with the config changes now if you'd like. Quick notes on comms and credits:

- Comms: we'll send a short customer-facing bulletin you can share with your internal teams summarizing what happened and the expected timeline.
- Credits: we'll evaluate a pro-rata credit for the impacted window; Marissa will confirm the exact amount after we finalize impacted session counts (should have a draft credit estimate by EOD Wed).

Below is the config snippet I mentioned — paste into your client SDK initialization:

// temp-config-snippet.txt (text)
{
  "streaming": {
    "stream_batch_size": 8,
    "max_tokens_per_emit": 12,
    "socket_keepalive_ms": 60000,
    "client_reconnect_backoff_ms": [250, 500, 1000]
  }
}

If you'd prefer, we can push a temporary feature flag on our side to force lower aggregation for NovaCart sessions; that avoids touching your code. Let me know which you prefer and what time works for a 30-min call.

Best,

- Closure: telemetry shows streaming latency median back to baseline and error-rate within SLA as of 14:30 PDT Wed.
- Postmortem: engineering is preparing the full postmortem and remediation checklist (link below). We will include the specific regression test we will add to prevent re-introducing the scheduling tweak.
